Port Moody real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends
Port Moody houses by price band, September 2026

15 houses sold in September against 135 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,500,001 to $1,750,000, with 5 sold (33% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $1,500,001 to $1,750,000 at 24%.

Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.
